full_effect_abi.scope: Complete normal 459d60 and 459e00 execute unmodified with real timer, quotient, remainder, transition and setters; only final 457890 is supplied. Every final call target/eax/edx/ebx/ecx, full 0x160 actor bytes and original EAX compare. Random saved FS:[0] tokens restore and return, independently of callback EAX; final callback actor mutations remain live. Exceptional unwinding and callbacks that alter the saved exception stack local are outside this boundary.

full_fight_effect_abi.scope: Complete normal 45a3e0 and 45a440 run unchanged with real timer, quotient, remainder, signed transition and setters. Only draws 4826c0 and final centering 457890 are supplied; every target/eax/edx/ebx/ecx, entire 0x160 actor before each call and after completion, and final original EAX compare. Arbitrary caller registers, wrapped timer values, full-width draw returns and live actor mutations at either draw and centering are covered. Callbacks preserve input registers other than returned EAX; faults and exceptional unwinding remain outside the normal boundary.

full_wave_abi.scope: Complete normal 45a750 and 45a830 execute unchanged. Only draws 4826c0 and final 457890 are supplied; target/eax/edx/ebx/ecx, complete actor state and live running 532bd0 state compare before every callback and after completion, along with final EAX. Running is read only once after due timer consumption; callback mutations to running and actor do not re-enter that branch. Faults and register-clobbering callbacks remain outside this boundary.

full_count_abi.scope: Complete normal 459be0 executes unchanged with real timer, quotient, remainder, angle/orbit, signed transition and setters; only voice 417260/417290 and final 457890 are supplied. Every call register and complete 0x160 actor/live voice-base state compare before callbacks and after completion. EAX returns random saved FS:[0], independent of callback results; SEH chain restores. Fixtures include arbitrary signed radius/limit/step, full-width factors, wrapped timers and full-width quotient with zero angle rate. Faulting division/table inputs, callback register clobbers and exceptional unwinding or mutations to the saved exception stack local remain outside the boundary.

scope: State comparisons only for the legacy status APIs: original handlers 0x459be0, 0x459d60, 0x459e00, 0x45a290, 0x45a3e0, 0x45a440, 0x45a620, 0x45a750 and 0x45a830 (with the real 0x4ac500/0x4ac540/0x4ac5b0, 0x4ad060, 0x4ad260, 0x4ad530 and 0x457890/0x4b14c0) runs in the oracle; only the sound players 0x417260/0x417290/0x4171e0/0x417220 and the generator draw 0x4826c0 are observed and returned. The first 0x160 actor bytes, including the handler token at +0x154, compare after every call.
